fieldMappings.data[].id: exact source model ID, including any vendor prefix; sourceId stays byte-for-byte intact and the live ID applies pinned qualifyOpenRouterModelId (prefix openrouter/ unless already present); live owner maps only to pinned OmniRoute openrouter provider
fieldMappings.data[].name: display name only

provenance.termsCaveat: OpenRouter Terms https://openrouter.ai/terms/ (updated 2026-08-31) §7(5) restricts automated scraping/copying. The official model-list API documentation https://openrouter.ai/docs/api/api-reference/models/list-all-models-and-their-properties documents GET /models but exposes a top-level API-key security declaration and no observed catalog-data license or reuse exception. The adapter uses only the documented fixed GET with credentials omitted; this provenance records no redistribution permission.
